+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

+
+class PaymentFailure(Exception):

+

+class GatewayTimeout(Exception):

+

+    """Cobranca recusada de forma definitiva."""

+        try:
+            return gateway.charge(order.total)

+    for event in args:
